findings.detail: Glossary drift: this namespace uses 'demonio'/'demonios', while the committed, shipped es relay.asks catalogue uses 'daemon' in error.reach_failed, error.no_reason and error.read_timeout; the W2 sibling cli.browser_help also uses 'daemon'. Neither the style guide nor glossary authorizes a daemon/demonio split. Current assigned values: cli.update_help.no_services: No pasar los demonios `lop serve` a la nueva compilación; los demonios supervisados sí se reparan. Usar solo cuando algo más vaya a iniciar esos demonios, p. ej., un script que controle su lanzamiento.
findings.remediation: Standardize on 'daemon'/'daemons' in these keys (and coordinate the adjacent W2 browser keys so the surface stays consistent). Keep all surrounding grammar and ICU bodies otherwise unchanged.

findings.detail: Current typography: 'de PyPI —la única compilación que incluye el agente de claves de macOS—; cualquier'. The Spanish guide requires an em dash with spaces (' — '). The published-wheel/key-agent behavioural distinction itself is accurate.
findings.remediation: Use 'de PyPI — la única compilación que incluye el agente de claves de macOS —; cualquier', preserving Spanish's spaced em dashes and no space before the semicolon. Alternatively restructure to 'de PyPI, la única compilación que incluye el agente de claves de macOS; cualquier' to avoid the parenthetical dash/semicolon junction.
